title: How to Add Cookie Consent
content:
## How to Add Cookie Consent


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102536

Implementing cookie consent functionality is essential for ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations. This process typically involves integrating a third-party cookie consent solution into a website. Such tools streamline the process by providing pre-built scripts and customizable interfaces to manage user consent.


### Select a Cookie Consent Tool


Choose a reliable third-party provider that aligns with the website's privacy requirements. Popular options include Cookiebot, OneTrust, and Osano ( click for example ). These tools offer comprehensive features, such as banner customization, consent tracking, and integration support.


### Adding Cookie Consent Code in Brilliant Directories


To integrate cookie consent functionality in a Brilliant Directories website, follow these steps:

- Access the Brilliant Directories Admin Dashboard . Be sure to be logged into your admin dashboard.

- Navigate to the Toolbox section and select Widget Manager . Locate the "Widget Manager" option within the Toolbox menu to manage the website's widgets.

- Search for the Bootstrap Theme - Cookie Consent Code widget. Use the search bar in the Widget Manager to find the specific widget dedicated to cookie consent.

- Insert the third-party snippet in the HTML editor. Open the widget in the editor and paste the provided cookie consent code snippet into the appropriate section of the HTML.

- Save the changes. Click on Save Changes to finalize and implement the updates on the website.
